name: Acruvium
traits: Mountain stronghold: with the citadel on the hill, a home battle gets +5 and even a small garrison holds. Narrow shore: 8 fields, 4 more to clear on the hillside; more land only from the tribes.
notes: DRAFT. The town lies in the innermost corner of the Gulf of Rhizon, a triangle between the river, the spring and the mountain, as Kotor does. The river is the Škurda and the spring the Gurdić; their ancient names are not recorded, so the game uses Latin forms (Scurda, Fons Gurdicus).
